# ROBORAB

> ROBORAB deploys AI agents in business processes: fitness CRM, tax agent, construction accounting, booking CRM, SEO and GEO. The diagnosis in the chat is free.

ROBORAB deploys AI agents into B2B business processes. The diagnosis in the chat is free; implementation is priced individually.

## Products
- Fitness CRM: clients, memberships, schedules, trainer payouts
- Tax agent: group-of-companies taxes, actuals from 1C, forecasts and scenarios
- Construction accounting: sites, materials and costs
- Booking CRM: hotel booking requests in one window
- SEO and GEO: setup, analytics, admin panels

## Languages
- [English (US)](https://roborab.vercel.app/)
